svg.title: Gold Medal — Geneva 2026
svg.desc: Honors: Sam Afshar won a Gold Medal at the 6th International Invention and Innovation Competition for IFIA Inv Title Holders, Geneva, Switzerland, 3 to 5 July 2026, for the invention "AI System for Seismic Collapse Risk Assessment and Digital Certification" (ANKA), and holds the IFIA Inv membership title, verification number IR2026MAY2987SXA.
